units.rawText: ...That miko dancing up there looks really graceful. She's accounted for all the ritual elements in her performance. Well done.
units.displayText: ...That miko dancing up there looks really graceful. She's accounted for all the ritual elements in her performance. Well done.

spans.text: ...That miko dancing up there looks really graceful. She's accounted for all the ritual elements in her performance. Well done.

units.rawText: That's a Universal Anything Services S55-HMK priestess Doll. Who'd have thought that even the mikos who commune with the gods would end up like this...
units.displayText: That's a Universal Anything Services S55-HMK priestess Doll. Who'd have thought that even the mikos who commune with the gods would end up like this...

units.rawText: Well, that's no good. The gods require sincere devotion. What do Dolls know of faith? They don't even have hearts.

spans.text: Well, that's no good. The gods require sincere devotion. What do Dolls know of faith? They don't even have hearts.

units.rawText: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy!
units.displayText: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy!

spans.text: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy!

units.rawText: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.
units.displayText: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.

spans.text: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.

units.rawText: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.
units.displayText: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.

spans.text: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.

units.rawText: At this rate... the kami will surely see...
units.displayText: At this rate... the kami will surely see...

spans.text: At this rate... the kami will surely see...

units.rawText: Will the kami... see this...
units.displayText: Will the kami... see this...

spans.text: Will the kami... see this...

units.rawText: Kimie...
units.displayText: Kimie...

spans.text: Kimie...

units.rawText: It seems Dolls are not fated to step into this field. I can use data analysis to sense abnormal energies around me, and I can flawlessly replicate purifying and exorcising rituals.

units.rawText: But this Kimie cannot hear the will of the gods.
units.displayText: But this Kimie cannot hear the will of the gods.

spans.text: But this Kimie cannot hear the will of the gods.

units.rawText: Helix squeezes Kimie's hands tightly. She senses the former is trembling, but all she can do is send her own warmth to her.
units.displayText: Helix squeezes Kimie's hands tightly. She senses the former is trembling, but all she can do is send her own warmth to her.

spans.text: Helix squeezes Kimie's hands tightly. She senses the former is trembling, but all she can do is send her own warmth to her.

spans.text: Soon, Kaede-sama stopped taking me on journeys with her, only instructing me and asking me to stay within the shrine.

units.rawText: In the end, even Kaede-sama realized this Kimie was no real miko, only a counterfeit blasphemy against the kami...
units.displayText: In the end, even Kaede-sama realized this Kimie was no real miko, only a counterfeit blasphemy against the kami...

spans.text: In the end, even Kaede-sama realized this Kimie was no real miko, only a counterfeit blasphemy against the kami...

units.rawText: It's not like that.
units.displayText: It's not like that.

spans.text: It's not like that.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: From what you said, Kaede-sama was protecting you, Kimie.
units.displayText: From what you said, Kaede-sama was protecting you, Kimie.

spans.text: From what you said, Kaede-sama was protecting you, Kimie.

units.rawText: But why would you say that, Helix-sama...
units.displayText: But why would you say that, Helix-sama...

spans.text: But why would you say that, Helix-sama...

units.rawText: Hayley... No, Helix...
units.displayText: Hayley... No, Helix...

spans.text: Hayley... No, Helix...

units.rawText: I have no choice. All I can do is delete myself from your memories... From now on, we will not contact each other...

spans.text: I have no choice. All I can do is delete myself from your memories... From now on, we will not contact each other...

units.rawText: May your world always be sunny and bright. May you never have to see its darkness...

spans.text: May your world always be sunny and bright. May you never have to see its darkness...

units.rawText: Helix... Helix doesn't know why either, but for some reason, I feel like I've had similar experiences... but I just can't recall the exact memories.
units.displayText: Helix... Helix doesn't know why either, but for some reason, I feel like I've had similar experiences... but I just can't recall the exact memories.

spans.text: Helix... Helix doesn't know why either, but for some reason, I feel like I've had similar experiences... but I just can't recall the exact memories.

units.rawText: In any case, Helix thinks that those orders that seemed so cold and heartless were actually separating you from the malice of others. She wasn't locking you up. She was protecting the most precious thing to her.

units.rawText: It's just like how a caterpillar metamorphoses into a butterfly. Without its cocoon, a butterfly wouldn't last long.

units.displayText: Are you happy living with everyone, Kimie?

units.rawText: I'm very happy, but also very afraid. This period is the happiest time this Kimie has had in Magrasea.

spans.text: I'm very happy, but also very afraid. This period is the happiest time this Kimie has had in Magrasea.

spans.text: I heard you talking with the Professor before. Are you still going to leave everyone and return to the shrine?

spans.text: Helix likes Kimie very much. Surely she'll stay behind, right?

spans.text: Helix-sama, Choco-sama...
